question: A class of 69 students took a Physics test. 17 students had an average score of 94 . The other students had an average score of 84 . What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume base average = 84.

Deviation of 17 students = 17 × (94 − 84) = +170.

Average deviation for all 69 students = 170 ÷ 69 ≈ 2.46.

Class average = 84 + 2.46 = 86.46 ≈ 86.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 86.5.**
